subject.title: fix(agents): remove abort listener on early reject paths in ls tool

question: Should this PR be narrowed back to the ls cleanup, or should the maintainer-authored broad follow-up commit be intentionally adopted as a separate large integration branch?
rationale: The broad commit was added by a maintainer after the first review, so automation should not guess whether to discard it, split it, or treat it as intentional product/workflow work.

options.title: Narrow this PR to ls cleanup
options.body: Drop or split the broad follow-up commit, keep only the ls refactor and focused tests, then require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt as a broad integration PR
options.body: Keep the broad commit only if a maintainer wants to review the workflows, apps, providers, protocol, docs, and UI changes as the real PR scope.

options.title: Replace with a fresh narrow PR
options.body: Close this source branch after opening a clean replacement that preserves the contributor's ls cleanup credit and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Narrow this PR to ls cleanup
recommendation.body: Drop or split the broad follow-up commit, keep only the ls refactor and focused tests, then require real behavior proof before merge.
